day-01.title: Confetti
day-01.desc: Send lands with a spring, a sheen, and a tight burst.

day-02.title: Password reveal
day-02.desc: Eye morphs. Mask softens into plain text.

day-03.title: Soft toggle
day-03.desc: Lagged ease on, no hard snap.

day-04.title: Segmented control
day-04.desc: Pill indicator eases between Day, Week, and Month.

day-05.title: Hold to confirm
day-05.desc: Hold builds pressure. Release cancels. Success lands.

day-06.title: Like burst
day-06.desc: Heart pops with a tiny particle burst on like.

day-07.title: Morph checkbox
day-07.desc: Custom check with a springy pop when it draws in.

day-08.title: Snap stepper
day-08.desc: Digits reel. Hold accelerates. Ends soft-disable.

day-09.title: Snap slider
day-09.desc: Drag free. Release and it springs to the tick.

day-10.title: Clear input
day-10.desc: Clear arrives softly. Clearing exhales the field.

day-11.title: OTP input
day-11.desc: Four cells. Type, paste, or backspace through.

day-12.title: Value scrub
day-12.desc: Drag the amount. Digits reel as it moves.

day-13.title: Slide to unlock
day-13.desc: Slide to commit. Early release springs home.

day-14.title: Copy link
day-14.desc: One click. Link copied. Check springs in.

day-15.title: Weekly pulse
day-15.desc: Bars spring in. Hover a day to read the pulse.

day-16.title: Drop zone
day-16.desc: Drop or browse. Card compresses. Name reels in.

day-17.title: Fart react
day-17.desc: Hold the bubble. It farts until you let go.

day-18.title: Flick snooze
day-18.desc: Flick the alarm. It flies. Five minutes reel in.

day-19.title: Peel
day-19.desc: Pull the corner. The paper folds. It snaps free.
